## Description

Models implied volatility dynamics using fractional Brownian motion with Hurst exponent $H &lt; 0.5$ to exploit short-memory volatility roughness and pricing inefficiencies across option strike chains.

## Where it may fit

Short-dated options trading, index volatility smile mispricings, volatility skew trading.

## Vehicles

Options trading desks, volatility arbitrage hedge funds.

## Required data

Intraday option chains, spot underlying quotes, implied volatility surface quotes.

## Caveats

Fast simulation requires hybrid scheme or exact Cholesky decomposition of fractional covariance matrices.

- <https://github.com/rough-path/rough-volatility>
- <https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.03456>
